title: Coding with LLMs in the summer of 2025 (an update) - <antirez>
summary: antirez argues frontier LLMs amplify skilled programmers when used in the loop with rich context, but produce fragile, bloated code when left alone, and recommends chat over agents for now.

assertions.quote: many were just removed immediately by Gemini / Claude code reviews.
letting the LLM write the throw away code to test ASAP
when left alone with nontrivial goals they tend to produce fragile code bases that are larger than needed
you need to provide extensive information to the LLM
you need at least two LLMs to do some back and forth for complex problems
don’t use agents or things like editor with integrated coding agents

verdicts.note: By late 2025 agentic tools became net-useful for many experienced engineers, though full manual control of context still helps on some hard problems.

assertions.quote: Work with technologies far from your expertise but contiguous with what you can do
